description:
## Why book an Inspection?

The **MYS Inspection Visit** is how Academic Monitors and Audit Officers cover Branches against shared checklists. Booking a visit generates the empty inspection record; the inspector fills in checklist items in the field, and any failing items auto-create `MYS Inspection Finding` records that flow into the corrective-action workflow.

Book one visit now — even a dry-run against your own Head Office Branch — to see the inspection lifecycle and the dashboards light up.
